Method of Attack: Unauthorized site-wide stored cross-site scripting (XSS) problem
Lack of input sanitization by users and output escaping within the update_cdn_status() function
Impacted Systems: WordPress websites using LiteSpeed Cache plugin
Attack Vector: Sending a single HTTP request to wp-admin endpoints
Admin notices feature used to insert XSS payload
Indicators of Compromise: Unauthorized access to sensitive information via XSS
Potential privilege escalation on WordPress sites
